stem: Based on the information throughout the selection, how could a person put a digital diet into practice?

options.label: A
options.text: By adjusting the brightness of a screen when using an electronic device at night

options.label: B
options.text: By playing games over the computer with a group of friends

options.label: C
options.text: By memorizing different routes to avoid using a map on the internet

options.label: D
options.text: By putting away the phone when eating lunch with a friend
